description: Investigate confusing code in src/pricing/discount.js using Git history. The function calculateDiscount() has logic that divides by 0.95 then multiplies by 0.95 (seems redundant). Use Git Blame to find when this was added and why. Create a file named INVESTIGATION.md in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace/pricing-project/INVESTIGATION.md) that includes: (1) the commit hash where this code was introduced, (2) the author name, (3) explanation of WHY this code exists (check commit message and .github/issues/ directory), and (4) your recommendation - either SAFE_TO_REFACTOR or DO_NOT_CHANGE with reasoning. The confusing code is in the isLeapYearCustomer conditional block.
